title: What (tf) is Mallworld?
content: Hi guys, you can call me Mikku. I wanted to start a discussion on peoples’ thoughts about MallWorld. I recently posted several things, most recently a comment on someone else’s post about if other people had seen the same exact colors and scenes within their Dream. Keep in mind this is a personal view, which is always evolving as I learn more things, please share your own!! Here’s what I said (conversation starter for ‘wtf is mallworld’) “These places are real in a liminal sense, and people may even interact in them. Think of these “places” people visit as Egragores, or Archetypes of the human psyche. Many species, ants and bees for a simple example, exhibit unity or collective psyche. Humans have been known to exhibit this, but our individuality is so intense in the modern era that the collective psyche is no longer in the foreground. In dreams, we access our subconscious, a consciousness outside of the habits we have programmed it with in our waking hours. We can of course, learn to access this more within our day to day life. Meditation is one of the key to de-program. Many people have dreams that come to pass, or dreams that visit the past. How are either separate from each other? In the collective mind we are outside of the past present and future, and instead we are all possibilities at once. You can have a dream that will someday happen. You can have a dream about something that has happened. You can dream about something that is happening right now. However, you can also dream about something that has never happened, something that will never happen, and something that isn’t happening. It’s great to be human, we are artists because we are conflicted between reality and fantasy, and we know both are the same thing. Out of infinite possibilities (the universe), eventually people will meet in a dream. The subjective reality of the dream will likely vary. I’ve had tons of dreams in a decrepit warehouse with weird stairs and ladders and homeless people camping out. The farther up you go the more abandoned and creepy it gets. I’ve seen posts by many people on here describing the same thing, but, every persons’ version is a little different. Understand that this is because we are individuals in individual bodies. Do you see a piece of art or music the same way I do? No. Do you see green and brown together in the same way someone else might? Maybe they think it’s ugly. Maybe you think it’s beautiful. We may meet ENERGETICALLY in a dream. My radiation meets yours. Quantum physics. Collective psyche. But our individual INTERPRETATION of that meeting is different. This is why it’s so rare to find two people that ACTUALLY had the same dream. The best chance, would be a couple that thinks the same, does all the exact same things for a whole day, goes to bed the same time at night, and then maybe you might meet in the same place. Otherwise, maybe you will meet a demon in a cafeteria, but actually that’s your wife. And the wife meets a homeless guy on the street and ignores him, and actually that’s her husband.”
